title: Maestro AI — Ontology & Knowledge Framework (OKF v2.0)
systemName: Maestro AI — The Autonomous Executive Event Producer

wedding.title: 1. The Peak Memory
wedding.prompt: What is the single moment that must happen for you to smile and say, 'That was the most unforgettable wedding in the world'?

wedding.title: 2. The Pulse & Vibe
wedding.prompt: Which combination best describes the atmosphere you envision? (A: Cultural Salon & Deep Conversation | B: Electric Jazz & Swing Speakeasy | C: Classic Black-Tie Banquet & Speeches)

wedding.title: 3. Musical Green & Red Lines
wedding.prompt: Which genre or track will get you flying onto the floor, and what is strictly off-limits?

wedding.title: 4. Culinary & Hospitality Priority
wedding.prompt: What matters most for guest comfort — Michelin-level tasting surprises, zero-wait bar flow, or quiet acoustic lounges for seniors and deep conversation?

wedding.title: 5. Heritage, Inclusion & Accessibility
wedding.prompt: Is there a family tradition, LGBTQ+/multicultural nuance, or senior mobility/acoustic need we should honor with special care?

corporate.title: 1. Primary Executive KPI
corporate.prompt: What is the #1 outcome this event must achieve — closing enterprise deals, team cohesion, or viral product-launch buzz?

corporate.title: 2. Attendee Takeaway
corporate.prompt: What is the exact sentence you want attendees saying on their way home across the Bay?

corporate.title: 3. Keynote vs. Networking Ratio
corporate.prompt: What is the ideal balance between stage keynotes/demos and interactive gallery networking?

corporate.title: 4. Production Aesthetic
corporate.prompt: Should the Flexible LED Skins project futuristic Silicon Valley cyber-glass or warm, sustainable community design?

corporate.title: 5. Operational Red Lines
corporate.prompt: Based on past company events, what bottleneck or friction must we eliminate at all costs?

operationalInferenceRules.name: Museum Turnaround & Rapid Load-In Rule
actions: Lock Load-In start strictly at Museum Close (17:00 PT).
Mandate Off-Site Pre-Rigging at Blueprint Studios & Argus HD warehouses 24h prior.
Deploy Jay's Small Moves rapid urban logistics fleet for 90-minute pier-to-gallery load-in.

operationalInferenceRules.name: Live Jazz & Glass/Steel Acoustic Damping Rule
actions: Mandate Argus HD Digital Signal Processing (DSP) & directional Line-Array calibration.
Deploy acoustic velvet draping by OrangePiel + luxury sound-absorbing carpets by The Rug Company.
Create a dedicated <65 dB Senior Acoustic Sanctuary in the Observatory Terrace.
Enforce mandatory 18:00 sharp Soundcheck prior to Doors Open.

operationalInferenceRules.name: High-Volume Speakeasy Grazing & Zero-Queue Rule
actions: Combine heavy Speakeasy Grazing Stations with synchronized seated courses by Paula LeDuc Fine Dining.
Deploy Double Espresso Subito artisan carts + 3 distributed Tonic Beverage mixology bars.
Activate The Caviar Co. VIP Lounge + Exploratorium 'Explainer' interactive science hosts.

operationalInferenceRules.name: Multi-Generational & Stakeholder Conflict Mediation Rule
actions: Split spatial acoustic zones across the 3 Museum Levels: Seated Banquet & Warm Conversation in Moore East Gallery, High-Energy Jazz Speakeasy in Bechtel/Mezzanine, and Quiet Waterfront Sanctuary in Fisher Bay Observatory Terrace.
Apply step-free elevator routing and high-contrast spatial wayfinding for senior guests.
